Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:


Nope. Legacy of Pander gives each untitled Pander "1 vote". Not 1
additional vote, or +1 votes. So each Legacy of Pander sets each
Pander's vote total to 1.

It's the same reason that multiple Rumors of Gehenna don't stack.
